title: ～中 (ちゅう／じゅう) — during ～, within ～
summary: The kanji 中 has two readings with different meanings. ちゅう means “in the middle of / during” (会議中), and じゅう means “throughout / within the whole of” (今日中). It attaches to nouns of time and activity.

patterns.form: 動作名詞 ＋ 中（ちゅう）
patterns.gloss: in the middle of (an action): 会議中, 勉強中, 使用中

patterns.form: 時間の名詞 ＋ 中（じゅう）
patterns.gloss: throughout / by the end of: 今日中, 今週中, 一日中

body.h: ちゅう: in the middle of
body.p: After a noun of an action, 中 (ちゅう) means that the action is going on now: 会議中 (in a meeting), 電話中 (on the phone). Signs use it often: 使用中, 営業中. The next example (会議中は…) means “while the meeting is going on.”
After a period of time, 中 (じゅう) means the whole of it or any time within it: 今日中に終わらせる (finish within today), 一日中 (all day long). With a deadline, it means “by the end of that period.”

examples.ja: 今日（きょう）中（じゅう）にこの仕事（しごと）を終（お）わらせます。
examples.romaji: Kyō-jū ni kono shigoto o owarasemasu.
examples.tr: I'll finish this work by the end of today.

examples.ja: 今週（こんしゅう）中（じゅう）に返事（へんじ）をください。
examples.tr: Please give me a reply by the end of this week.

examples.ja: 会議（かいぎ）中（ちゅう）は携帯電話（けいたいでんわ）の電源（でんげん）を切（き）ってください。
examples.romaji: Kaigi-chū wa keitai denwa no dengen o kitte kudasai.
examples.tr: Please turn off your cell phone during the meeting.

pitfalls: Mind the reading: 今日中 is きょうじゅう (within today), 会議中 is かいぎちゅう (during the meeting).
With a period of time, 〜中に means a deadline. Do not use it for something that will continue after the period.
